description.text: The School of Economics offers four specialties, namely, Economics, International Economics and Trade, Financing, Taxation; besides, the school has a training base for economics personnel and a class of international economics and trade (business English). Established in 2000, the specialty of economics has been developed into two key subjects that to be built respectively by the provincial department and the school, namely, National Economy and Political Economy. Among the other two specialties established in 1987, financing is a special discipline to be built by Jiangsu province as well as a school key subject. The school of Economics has around 900 undergraduates and postgraduates, 66 full-time teachers, 12 professors, 26 associate professors, 30 PhDs and PhD candidates. One staff member enjoys special allowance from the State Council. In recent years, the school has published over 50 well-known textbooks in fields of national economy, world economy, industrial economy, regional economy, international trade, financing and taxation. Besides, the school has published over 600 theses, accomplished over 40 national, ministerial and provincial research projects, and won over 30 teaching and research projects. B.A. Economics Objectives: This program trains students with modern economics theory. Students are required to launch qualitative research and quantitative analysis of economic problems, to understand policies well and extend to other fields concerned with economics, as well as to practice and innovate. The graduates will be qualified for the work of economy analyzing, predicting, and economic management in government, policy research department, financing institution and enterprises. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree Main Courses: Political Economics, Micro-Economics, Macro-Economics, International Trade, International Finance, Monetary and Banking, Public Finance, Statistics, Calculative Economics, Guidance to Capital, Industry Economics, History of Foreign Economic Theory, Development Economics, Management, Operational Research, Investment Economics, Economy Estimate and Decision, System Economics, History of Chinese Economy, World Economy, Chinese Macro-Economic Analysis.

duration.text: The Economics at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
